scope: Read-only inspection of the user's authenticated ClickUp workspace and local PMS implementation

observed.result: Inspected grouped statuses, custom Tax Period field, assignee controls, search, filter, group, columns, view navigation and task links.

Inspected status, assignees, start/due dates, priority, timer, tags, description editor, fields, subtask/checklist/file entry points, dependency/relationship menu and discussion/activity tabs. No writes performed.
Navigation attempted; snapshot retained list content. Board rendering not verified.
Verified month grid, month navigation, Today, period selector, assignee/search/filter controls and overdue/unscheduled counts.

Inspected catalog including list, Gantt, calendar, doc, board, form, artifact, dashboard, gallery, table, whiteboard, timeline, activity, workload, mind map, team, map, collection and embeds. Catalog visibility does not establish functionality.
Blocked by account dashboard trial limit and upgrade modal. No upgrade attempted.
Inspected team/people/org-chart navigation, online/offline activity, date navigation, status/team/account/manager filtering and work focus display.

implemented.behavior: All work, overdue, due today, blocked, unassigned and unscheduled controls with contextual counts, icons, selected states and mobile layout. Existing project/assignee/status/priority/type/search filters continue to apply. Focus saves with existing device-scoped workspace view. Outstanding queues exclude terminal/cancelled tasks. Local date changes refresh without reload.
implemented.preservation: Existing grid, custom fields, bulk actions, assignment drag/drop, workflow checks, task cards and team views retained.
validation: node qa/workspace_focus_browser.cjs passed at 1440px and 390px with mocked API data: list/board filtering, saved view restoration, clear filters and empty results
implemented.deployment: Local source only; production behavior and production data not tested.

remaining_review: Individual advanced view functionality and plan availability
Broader PMS workflow acceptance against the user's own configured projects
